description: One libsignal ciphertext addressed by tag. The recipient, ratchet counter and sender-key distribution id are inside the ciphertext, never in plaintext.

main.description: One libsignal ciphertext addressed by tag. The recipient, ratchet counter and sender-key distribution id are inside the ciphertext, never in plaintext.

tag.description: Rotating pairwise tag (a short HMAC value only the two parties can compute), or the recipient's public first-contact tag when envelopeType is firstContact.

envelopeType.description: Kind of libsignal envelope carried in ciphertext.

ciphertext.description: Opaque libsignal ciphertext. The plaintext is a DAG-CBOR encoded is.neuros.atsignal.defs#plaintext.
